newsitem.title: USA: American Stores to post Q4, $0.41/shr charge.
newsitem.headline: American Stores to post Q4, $0.41/shr charge.

text.p: American Stores Co said Monday it plans to take a charge of about $100 million, or $0.41 per share, in the fourth quarter, largely from a one-time write off of the book value of existing assets.
The charge is related to the implementation of so-called "Delta initiatives," a series of changes designed to transform American Stores from a holding company into a unified operating company.

Those changes include the consolidation of four general merchandise warehouses as well as its administrative offices. Those changes are now under way and are expected to be completed within the current fiscal year.
American Stores Chairman and Chief Executive Vic Lund said in a statement that it remains "on target to have benefits exceed costs in the last half of 1997" from the program.
